내 이름 아래에 오늘 밤이라고 적혀 있다. 죽는 날이. 먹이 아직 젖어: Beside my name, it says tonight. The night I die. The ink is still wet.
Did Sohwa see it too? She keeps watching the door.
His Majesty is waiting. Give me your hand. If anyone calls you, look at me first.
Father? He said I wasn't to let anyone see my face.
I know. Hold my hand tight, then. Even if you're shaking, don't let go.
등 뒤에서 빗장이 떨어진다. 아버지는 모란 족자를 펴신다. 차가 식는데도: The bar falls into place behind us. Father unrolls a peony painting. The tea grows cold, but he never tells me to drink.
Come closer. Tell me what you notice about these flowers.
Father is watching my face, not the flowers.
꽃 사이의 빈자리를 훑는다: Look at the empty spaces between the flowers
족자를 들어 뒤축을 만진다: Lift the scroll and feel behind the roller
창밖으로 빠져나갈 곳을 찾는다: Look for a way out through the window
There aren't any bees. All these flowers, and not one butterfly either.
You have sharp eyes. Now look beyond the painting.
…조용해요. 아까 문밖에 서 있던 사람들은요?: ...It's quiet. Where are the people who were outside the door?
찻잔에 손을 뻗자 소화가 내 손목을 붙든다. 소매를 잡아당기며 창 쪽으로: I reach for the tea. Sohwa catches my wrist, tugs my sleeve and glances toward the window.
Father's cup hasn't moved either. He hasn't taken a single sip.
족자 뒤축에서 얇은 종이가 흘러내린다. 붉은 인장 아래, 조금 전 읽었던: A thin sheet slips from behind the scroll's roller. Beneath a red seal, I see the name I read a moment ago.
왕실 족보 — 둘째 공주 덕만. 사망: 오늘 밤. 왕명에 따라 즉시 화장: Royal genealogy. Second Princess Deokman. Died: tonight. Immediate cremation by royal command.
That's your seal, Father, isn't it? But here... the corner's missing.
My seal is undamaged. Don't touch it with your bare hands. Use your sleeve.
문밖에서 쇠붙이가 긁힌다. 소화가 입술에 손가락을 댄다. 나는 소매로 종: Metal scrapes outside. Sohwa presses a finger to her lips. I fold the paper with its edge wrapped in my sleeve.
오른쪽 아래가 깨져 있어. 다른 데 찍힌 것도 이럴까?: The bottom-right corner's broken. Would it look like that on other papers too?
왕이 가리키는 창으로 간다: Go to the window the king points to
창턱에 뺨을 대니 돌이 차다. 왼쪽 담 아래로 물소리가 새어 나온다. 들: The sill is cold against my cheek. Water murmurs beneath the left wall. Under a raised stone slab, there is room to slip a hand through.
Water goes out under that wall. I think I could fit through too.
I asked you to look at flowers, and you found a way out.
Sohwa keeps watching the door. I think someone's come looking for me again.
...Yes. Someone has written a notice of your death. While you are standing here alive.
덕만아. 이 모란에 향기가 있겠느냐?: Deokman. Do you think these peonies have a scent?
Father's hand stops above his cup as he waits for my answer.
사라진 벌과 나비를 짚는다: Point out the missing bees and butterflies
사망 기록을 왕 앞에 펼친다: Lay the death record before the king
그림만 보고는 모른다고 버틴다: Insist that a picture cannot tell you that
I don't think so. If they smelled sweet, bees would have come.
Whoever sent this painting means to mock me for having no son.
But I have you. ...And only now do I say it.
이것부터 봐 주세요. 누가 저를 죽었다고 썼어요. 아버지 도장까지 찍어서: Please look at this first. Someone wrote that I died. They even used your seal.
나는 그런 명을 내린 적 없다. 그 종이를 어디서…: I gave no such order. Where did you find that paper...
저를 보세요. 제가 여기 있잖아요. 아버지가 아니라고 해 주시면—: Look at me. I'm right here. If you tell them it isn't true...
덕만아, 손을 펴 보아라. 그 검은 것은… 놓아라! 어서!: Deokman, open your hand. That black stain... Drop it! Now!
The king knocks the paper away. Deokman looks at his face instead of the falling sheet. She tries to speak, but her tongue will not move. Blackness spreads from her fingertips beneath her sleeve.
별궁 진료 기록 — 둘째 공주 덕만, 왕실 금지 문서의 독성 인주에 중독: Detached palace medical record. Second Princess Deokman died of poisoning from toxic seal paste on a forbidden royal document. Document and body cremated immediately.
소매에서 꺼낸 종이의 인주가 손에 묻었다. 진평왕은 딸의 이름을 거듭 불: Seal paste from the paper inside her sleeve had stained her hand. King Jinpyeong called his daughter's name again and again. Deokman never answered.
It's a painting. I can't even smell it.
That would be a comfortable answer. I too have spent too long refusing to look.
Your Majesty. There's a child outside with medicine... I did not send that child.
소화가 잔을 빼앗았다. 덕만은 입안에 남은 쓴맛을 삼키려 했다. 아버지가: Sohwa snatches the cup away. Deokman tries to swallow the bitterness left in her mouth. Father rises, but the floor tilts before she can reach him.
별궁 진료 기록 — 둘째 공주 덕만, 급작스러운 열병으로 사망. 독물 흔: Detached palace medical record. Second Princess Deokman died of a sudden fever. No traces of poison.
An unfamiliar servant had left the tea. Sohwa shattered the cup. The king called for a physician. Both sounds reached Deokman from far away.
너희가 태어났을 때부터였다. 저들은 천명 곁에 서거나, 네 곁에 서겠다: It began when you were born. They declared they would stand with Cheonmyeong, or with you.
So you hid me? I thought my sister stayed away because she didn't like me.
I thought they could not hurt a face they had never seen. You were waiting for me... and I looked away.
그럼 오늘은요? 또 여기서 기다려요? 아버지 올 때까지?: Then what about today? Do I wait here again? Until you come?
No. Don't wait for me. Go with Sohwa. ...I will let go of your hand.
Your Majesty, I smell oil beneath the western eaves. It wasn't there before.
Sohwa. Take this child... please. Go now.
들보가 갈라지는 소리에 귀가 먹먹하다. 소화의 손이 나를 잡아끈다. 아버: A beam splits with a crack that deafens me. Sohwa pulls me away. Fire hides the place where Father was standing.
문 하나가 닫힌다. 또 하나. 연기 저편에서 걸어오는 사람은 기침도 하지: One door closes. Then another. A man walks through the smoke without coughing. Chilsuk.
The princess has died of a fever. I have come to collect her body.
나 여기 있어. 보고 있잖아!: I'm here. You're looking right at me!
That does make things awkward. The document bears His Majesty's seal, after all.
칠숙의 엄지 아래로 칼날이 드러난다. 소화가 내 앞에 선다. 돌아선 어깨: A blade appears beneath Chilsuk's thumb. Sohwa steps in front of me. Her turned shoulder fills my view.
소화의 소매가 찢어진다. 나는 맨살이 드러난 손목을 붙든다. 자꾸 미끄러: Sohwa's sleeve tears. I grab the bare wrist beneath it. It keeps slipping. I squeeze harder.
Head down. Keep your mouth closed. Just follow me.
소화가 내 손바닥에 모란패를 밀어 넣는다. 달아오른 금속이 살에 달라붙는: Sohwa pushes a peony token into my palm. Hot metal sticks to my skin. It hurts too much to open my hand.
This token will open the north gate. But the guards will remember your face.
제가 먼저 가시라고 해도 듣지 마셔요. 오늘은… 제 말 안 들으셔도 됩니: Even if I tell you to go ahead, don't listen. Today... you don't have to do as I say.
Sohwa's hand is slipping. I have to find a way out.
모란패를 치켜들고 북문을 연다: Raise the peony token and open the north gate
기록을 품고 불길 너머 왕에게 간다: Carry the record through the fire to the king
모란 화단에 엎드려 불길을 피한다: Lie down in the peony bed to escape the flames
소화의 손을 잡고 배수로로 뛴다: Take Sohwa's hand and run for the drain
왼쪽 담. 아까 그 돌판이다. 손톱 밑으로 모래가 파고든다. 돌이 들리자: The left wall. The stone slab I saw before. Sand digs beneath my nails. As the slab rises, the smell of wet earth washes over my face.
Go in first. I'll hold the stone.
No. Give me your hand first. You told me not to let go.
무릎부터 진흙에 박힌다. 뒤에서 무너지는 소리에 몸이 움츠러든다. 붙잡은: My knees hit the mud. A crash behind us makes me flinch. The hand in mine squeezes once, hard.
...My lady? Why won't you speak? Please look at me.
I'm here. I'm right here, Sohwa. ...You got out too.
소화의 손을 잡고 국경으로 향한다: Take Sohwa's hand and head for the border
그날 밤 별궁에서 둘째 공주가 죽었다고 기록되었다. 성 밖 물가에서는 아: That night, the record said the second princess had died in the detached palace. Beside the water outside the walls, a child would not let go of her nurse's wet clothes.
모란패를 본 문지기가 빗장을 들었다. 반쯤 열린 문 너머로 말의 코김이: The guard lifts the bar at the sight of the peony token. Beyond the half-open gate, horses breathe white in the cold air. The waiting riders do not move aside.
Stop. Those horses... they're waiting with the reins in hand.
Sohwa, the gate's closing. We haven't got out yet.
You showed your token, I hear. Thank you. It made the right gate very easy to find.
칠숙이 손을 내렸다. 소화가 덕만을 품에 끌어안았다. 문 위에서 활시위: Chilsuk lowers his hand. Sohwa pulls Deokman against her chest. Above the gate, bowstrings draw together.
모란패가 돌바닥을 굴렀다. 덕만은 그것을 주우려 몸을 기울였다. 소화의: The peony token rolls across the stones. Deokman leans to pick it up. Sohwa's arms do not let her go. They no longer tighten either.
북문 당직 기록 — 화재 중 침입한 신원 미상 여인 둘을 사살함. 왕실: North gate watch record. Two unidentified women entering during the fire shot dead. Royal peony token recovered.
운명 — 문을 연 표식: Fate: the token that opened the gate
문을 열어 준 모란패를 문지기가 거두어 갔다. 덕만과 소화는 북문 밖으로: The guard took back the token that had opened the gate. Deokman and Sohwa never took a single step outside it.
아버지께 가야 했다. 덕만은 소화의 팔을 끌어 문서 통로로 뛰었다. 침전: She had to reach Father. Deokman pulls Sohwa toward the document passage. Firelight spills through the doors to his chamber.
잠겼습니다! 아기씨, 뒤로 오셔요. 종이는 두고요!: It's locked! My lady, come back. Leave the paper!
아버지! 저 안 죽었어요! 여기 좀 열어 주세요!: Father! I'm not dead! Please open the door!
문틈에 밀어 넣은 종이가 반쯤 걸렸다. 덕만이 다시 문을 두드리는 사이,: The paper catches halfway through the crack. As Deokman knocks again, a rafter falls behind them. Sohwa covers the child's nose and mouth with her sleeve.
별궁 화재 수습 기록 — 침전 아래 통로에서 둘째 공주 덕만과 유모 소화: Detached palace fire recovery record. Bodies of Second Princess Deokman and nurse Sohwa found beneath the royal chamber. Forged death record destroyed by fire.
운명 — 불길 안으로 가져간 증거: Fate: evidence carried into the fire
There is no answer beyond the door. Deokman keeps her hand against it to the end. Sohwa lays her own hand over the child's.
화단의 흙이 서늘했다. 덕만이 얼굴을 묻자 꽃뿌리 사이에서 기름 냄새가: The soil in the flower bed is cool. As Deokman buries her face, the smell of oil rises between the roots. Before Sohwa can lift her, flames race around the edge.
눈 뜨셔요. 여기 제 손 있지요? 잡으셔야지요!: Open your eyes. My hand's right here, see? You have to take it!
Sohwa... even the flowers are burning.
별궁 화재 보고 — 열병으로 죽은 둘째 공주 덕만의 시신과 유모 소화가: Detached palace fire report. Body of Second Princess Deokman, deceased of fever, and nurse Sohwa burned beyond identification.
운명 — 먼저 준비된 죽음: Fate: a death prepared in advance
담으로 가는 길이 무너진 들보에 막혔다. 소화는 아이를 안고 화단을 벗어: A fallen beam blocked the way to the wall. Sohwa tried to carry the child out of the flower bed. The fire reached them first.
My name on the paper. Footsteps stopping outside the door.
소화에게 종이를 가리킨다: Point out the paper to Sohwa
Tonight? It isn't even night yet.
문틈에 귀를 붙인다. 누군가 바로 너머에 있다. 숨을 죽이자 바깥에서 쇠: I press my ear to the crack. Someone is right outside. I hold my breath. A metal latch clicks into place.
왜 밖에서 잠그지? 안에 사람 있다고 말할까…: Why lock it from outside? Should I tell them someone's in here...
Wax drips onto the edge of the paper. I reach to move it before I get scolded, then stop. That's my name. And beside it...
내 죽음에 붉은 인장을 찍은 손도 아직 어딘가에 있다. 소화가 내 손을: The hand that stamped my death in red is still out there. Sohwa presses my hand to her face. It's wet. I don't ask whether it's rain or tears.
